sloka: सनातने वर्त्मानि सम्निविष्टाम् ।रामेक्षणां तां मदनाभिविष्टाम् ।भर्तुर्मनः श्रीमदनुप्रविष्टाम् ।स्त्रीभ्यो वराभ्यश्च सदा विशिष्टाम् ॥५-५-२४॥
transliteration: sanātane vartmāni samniviṣṭām ।rāmekṣaṇāṁ tāṁ madanābhiviṣṭām ।bharturmanaḥ śrīmadanupraviṣṭām ।strībhyo varābhyaśca sadā viśiṣṭām ॥5-5-24॥

translations.english: 'Sita must have had a pair of beautiful eyes. She must have been a passionate lady with mind fixed on her glorious husband. Ever established in dharma, she is perhaps a distinguished lady compared to her counterparts (in Lanka).
